1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles having a size of __8-12 micrometers or 30-50 micrometers__; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy or a thermally conductive ceramic glue__.

3. (Original) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.
